items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Jonah Jones and all the guys was in that band... And the winter of '36, I went up to join her... Jonah Jones and them was in there.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WORTH 2-2915 WORTH 2-2943

And Lil Armstrong was gigging, and Charlie Green said she wanted to work. So Charlie Green bought her that band -- Stuff Smith's band. Stuff got a small band. Jonah Jones and all the guys was in that band. (Inaudible) Stuff Smith's band.
And the winter of '36, I went up to join her, and that's when I met the Will Mastin Trio.
